l: Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia), Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia), Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia)
s: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia) describes the event that will shake the earth, grind the hills to dust, and divide people into three groups. Those brought nigh and those on the right hand receive gardens, nourishment, peace, and delight, while those on the left hand, including the erring deniers and rejecters, face scorching wind, boiling water, the tree called Zaqqum, and hell-fire. The text calls human beings to recognize that the Lord of the Worlds creates them, controls death, cultivates plants, sends water, and causes fire. It declares the noble Qur'an to be a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds, kept in a hidden Book, and calls Muhammad to praise the name of his Lord.

l: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia), Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia), Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia)
s: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia) concerns the event, the division of people into three groups, their respective outcomes, and signs of the Lord of the Worlds' power.

s: The event will befall without denial, abase some, exalt others, shake the earth, and reduce the hills to scattered dust.

l: the earth, Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia), Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia)
s: The earth will be shaken with a shock when the event befalls.

s: Those on the right hand receive gardens, shade, flowing water, abundant fruit, raised couches, and peace. They include a multitude of those of old and a multitude of those of later time.

l: those on the left hand, Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia), Surah 56: The Inevitable (Al-Waaqia)
s: Those on the left hand are in scorching wind, scalding water, and black smoke. They persisted in awful sin and will face a terrible welcome on the Day of Judgment.
